# LawyerCostGuide
# Real Legal Fees — By City & Practice Area
# https://lawyercostguide.com

## About
LawyerCostGuide provides independently researched, BLS-adjusted attorney fee data for 12 legal practice areas across 161 US cities. All pricing data is sourced from Bureau of Labor Statistics Regional Price Parities and ABA Legal Technology surveys, adjusted quarterly. Data is never influenced by commercial relationships with law firms.

## Data Type
attorney fee estimates, legal cost benchmarks, city-adjusted legal pricing

## Coverage
161 US cities including: New York, NY, Los Angeles, CA, Chicago, IL, Houston, TX, Phoenix, AZ, Philadelphia, PA, San Antonio, TX, San Diego, CA and 153 more.

## Update Frequency
Quarterly — last updated March 2026

## Methodology
All cost estimates are calculated using Bureau of Labor Statistics Regional Price Parity indices applied to national baseline data from verified industry sources. Full methodology: https://lawyercostguide.com/methodology
